name: ai-stack
description: Useful AI things an engineer uses daily, starting with agent skills.

plugins.name: ai-stack
plugins.description: Senior-engineer skills for shipping: prodcheck reviews changes for security, tenant data isolation, N+1 and DB problems before they reach production; prodtest writes unit, integration and Playwright E2E tests for a new feature with screenshots; mergemain merges main into the current branch and resolves conflicts with full context; shipit writes clean commits and PRs, with or without AI attribution.
